system.effect: Once per encounter, reduce one forced movement against you by up to 3 feet, to a minimum of 0 feet. Decide when its distance is determined. This does not change the Attack’s Result, prevent damage or conditions, or stop movement caused by a fall.
system.description: You give ground by inches when an impact should have driven you much farther.
system.automation: [EFFECT Reduce forced movement by up to 3 feet; IF: CLAIM(would forcibly move); LIMIT: encounter]

rules.error: EFFECT wraps an effect line, `[EFFECT <tag>: ...]`: CHECK, ATK, DEF, INIT, SPEED, IMMUNE, MARK, REROLL, IGNORE
